soldier: The head capsule is yellowish tinged with brown, the left mandible dark brown, the labrum white with the anterior half yellow, the antennae yellowish brown; the pronotum pale yellowish brown, the legs slightly paler, the abdomen pale yellowish white. The head capsule bears a few scattered long bristles, four at the apex of the labrum, and two to three on each anterolateral margin of the postmentum; bristles also arise on the anterior margin and the posterolateral margins of the pronotum. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.55–0.58, the sides almost parallel and slightly widening posteriorly, the anterior half narrower, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave, the median suture distinct and more than two-thirds of the length of the head capsule; in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head is straight and the frons forms a slope of about 30 degrees, the fontanelle being slightly projecting. The middle section of the left mandible is strongly twisted, the mandibular apex swollen and bluntly rounded; the right mandible is shorter and sabre-like, with a pointed apex. Antennae with 14 segments, segments 2 and 4 both short, the segments from the fifth onwards longer. The postmentum is slender and long, widest in front of the anterior one-fifth, the constriction index of the waist region about 0.47. The pronotum is saddle-shaped, with a distinct median incision on the anterior margin. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2.
